ACK delay hook originally matched unarmed unsolicited broadcasts; actual received frames diagnosed it, guard corrected; actual new turns updated all3 clients together
Raw MySQL row-hash observer needed bytes rather than UTF8 decoding; corrected before any deployment
Web replacement briefly broke old port-forward TLS connection; existing unit reconnected and trusted HTTPS returned200
Read-only queue observer initially expected an END marker; corrected to Beanstalk OK byte-length framing
qualificationLimits: Real WeChat/mobile hardware, production release and long-term capacity not qualified
